messages.content: It's extremely hot today and my air conditioner is currently turned off. Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour

function.name: ThinQ_Connect
function.description: Sends a command to control an appliance, allowing only a single value to be sent in one call. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

body.description: A dictionary containing the parameters for the appliance command.

airConJobMode.description: The current job mode of the air conditioner.

windStrength.description: The strength of the air flow.

monitoringEnabled.description: Whether air quality sensor monitoring is enabled.

airCleanOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air cleaning function.

airConOperationMode.description: The operation mode for the air conditioner, indicating if it is turned on or off.

powerSaveEnabled.description: Whether power save mode is enabled to conserve energy.

targetTemperature.description: The target temperature to set for the appliance, in degrees Celsius.

relativeHourToStop.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeMinuteToStop.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should stop. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to stop.

relativeHourToStart.description: The number of hours from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

relativeMinuteToStart.description: The number of minutes from the current time when the appliance should start. If set to null, the appliance will not be scheduled to start.

message.reasoning:
We need to call ThinQ_Connect with appropriate parameters. The user wants: start cooling at 20°C, mid wind strength, power off after an hour. The AC is currently turned off. So we need to set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON? Actually they want to start cooling at 20°C mid wind strength. That means we need to set airConOperationMode to POWER_ON, airConJobMode to COOL, targetTemperature 20, windStrength MID. Then schedule power off after an hour: relativeHourToStop = 1, relativeMinuteToStop = 0. Also relativeHourToStart and relativeMinuteToStart? They want to start cooling now? They say "Set it to start cooling at 20 degrees Celsius mid wind strength. power off after an hour". So start now. So relativeHourToStart = 0, relativeMinuteToStart = 0? Or maybe we don't need to set start times; just set operation mode to POWER_ON. But to schedule stop after an hour, we set relativeHourToStop=1. So call function.

We need to produce JSON body. Let's do:

{
  airConJobMode: "COOL",
  windStrength: "MID",
  airConOperationMode: "POWER_ON",
  targetTemperature: 20,
  relativeHourToStop: 1,
  relativeMinuteToStop: 0
}

We can also set other defaults. Provide the function call.
